test.create_query: CREATE TABLE empty_in_prewhere ( id UInt64, uuid UUID, INDEX uuid_bf uuid TYPE bloom_filter(0.01) GRANULARITY 1 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS index_granularity = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO empty_in_prewhere SELECT number, reinterpretAsUUID(unhex(leftPad(hex(number), 32, '0'))) FROM numbers(2000000)
test.query: SELECT id FROM empty_in_prewhere PREWHERE uuid IN ( SELECT toUUID('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') FROM numbers(0) ) FORMAT Null
